about_the_game:
There's always a lot going on in Master Eder's workshop - especially when Pumuckl has to tidy up. But while tidying up, he finds a strange bottle, a ship in a bottle, and something is moving inside! With nerve-racking curiosity, Pumuckl opens the bottle containing the ship. Before Pumuckl can shout “darn bottle thing!”, he is sucked into a magical vortex - directly into the ship inside the bottle!

There he wakes up on the deck of the “Gloria Bartholomia”, a gigantic, enchanted pirate ship that is bigger than any bottle could possibly fit.

Here he meets the quirky, forgetful Captain Krimskrams. He asks Pumuckl for help: the king and his ghost knights have cursed the ship and blocked all the magical doors - except the one through which Pumuckl entered. Only the pirate king's crown can lift the spell. This crown is supposed to fulfill every wish - if you earn it.

But the ship is a magical structure with doors to other worlds: tropical islands, enchanted ruins, an ancient pirate castle - even other ships. Tricky puzzles, ghost pirates, goblin traps and mini-games await Pumuckl and Krimskrams everywhere. They are accompanied by the cheeky parrot Krakula, who gives helpful tips - or is amused by their misadventures.

Gameplay-Features:

  • Puzzle Level: Pumuckl moves through isometric 3D levels

  • Mini-games: Memory, collecting quests or tricky challenges

  • Multiplayer co-op: Second player can help out as Captain Odds and ends (locally or online).

  • Parrot clues: Krakula gives clues or mocks

  • Enemies: Ghosts and skeletons - can be defeated by throwing things at them, solving puzzles or playing mini-games

  • Level structure: four thematic areas

  • Final Boss Fight: The Pirateking with multiple phases – puzzle, combat, reaction.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GT 1030 (2 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 560 (2 GB) or Intel UHD Graphics 630
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: The famous German kobold Pumuckl is back with a 3D puzzle adventure game “Pumuckl and the Crown of the Pirateking”. The player controls Pumuckl through 3D puzzle levels, plays mini-games, solves tricky challenges and has to defeat ghostly enemies.
